name: Zaïra
text:
my click and collect order was marked as collected but i never got it, the store says come back tomorrow, can you check the footage, thanks,
Zaïra

name: Winkelvoss
text:
the laptop repair was quoted at 80 but the invoice came in at 145 with no call first, i asked for a breakdown n was told its standard, please review the charges b4 i pay, regards,
Winkelvoss

name: Helfried Frenk
text:
the smart doorbell stopped recording to the cloud after the last update n motion alerts are delayed by ten minutes, i have reset it twice n reconnected the network with no change, three parcels went missing from the porch in that time, please fix the recording or replace the unit, thanks,
Helfried Frenk

name: Çiya Beltramo
text:
the gym induction i booked never appeared on the system n i was turned away at the door, second time this week, can you confirm the booking, cheers,
Çiya Beltramo

name: Ilka
text:
the car hire return was fine but the deposit hasnt come back after three weeks, i have the handover photos showing no damage, please release the hold or tell me what is pending, thanks,
Ilka

name: Noreisch
text:
the standing order for the tennis club went through twice in april n the club says it only received one, the bank says both left my account, i have statements for the whole period, this is the second time this year, please find the missing payment, thanks,
Noreisch

name: di Corcia
text:
my parcel locker code never arrived n the parcel went back after five days, nobody told me, can you get it redelivered, thanks,
di Corcia

name: Hazra Senida
text:
the dry cleaning came back with a mark on the collar that wasnt there before, the shop says it was like that but i have a photo from drop off, please redo the jacket or refund it, regards,
Hazra Senida

name: Teofana
text:
the online course i paid for wont play past lesson two n the download links are dead, i have tried two browsers n the app, the support chat keeps closing without an answer, i want either the videos fixed or my money back, this is week three of trying, thanks,
Teofana

name: Spoletini
text:
the click and collect locker jammed with my order inside n its been two days, the staff say they cant open it, can you sort it today, thanks,
Spoletini

name: Zeitin Heyder
text:
the bus pass renewal never went through n my card stopped working on monday, i topped up twice n the money is showing but the card is still blocked, please fix it before the weekend, thanks,
Zeitin Heyder

name: Grometto Fenato Parola
text:
the hotel charged the room to my card twice and the booking site says the payment failed, i have the confirmation n both bank entries dated the same minute, the hotel wont answer emails and the phone goes to a queue that cuts off, please get one charge refunded, thanks,
Grometto Fenato Parola

name: Casnici
text:
the tool hire shop wont refund the deposit cos they say the drill came back damaged, the photo shows a scratch thats on their own shelf, thanks,
Casnici

name: Laté
text:
Hi there, the allotment inspection is set for the 9th and the committee will walk the plots in the morning. Could you clear the path by plot 4 before then. The shed roof also needs a look. Thanks,
Laté

name: Mihill
text:
Hi, thanks for the quote for the gutter work, the price is fine but we need it done before the end of the month because of the survey. Can you confirm the date and whether the scaffolding is included. Also, please send the insurance certificate, the last one lapsed. Regards,
Mihill

name: Fürthaler Organ
text:
Hi, the keys for the meeting room are with the porter from tomorrow. Please pick them up before eight. Regards,
Fürthaler Organ

name: Kohonen Olowoye
text:
Hi, the rota for december is done and there are two gaps on the 24th. Could you let me know if you can cover either shift. Everyone else has replied. Thanks,
Kohonen Olowoye

name: Nazek
text:
Hi, the rehearsal room clashes with the choir on thursday and the choir has priority as it was booked first. I have moved the drama group to the small hall for this week only. Please pass the change to the parents. The timetable is updated on the board. Thanks,
Nazek

name: Smith
text:
Hi, the water meter reading is due and the key safe code has changed. The new code is with the office. Thanks,
Smith

name: Dianella Refaey Rusiecki
text:
Hi, the fixtures list for the spring season is attached and there are two clashes with the school. We can move the first but the second needs a referee swap. Let me know by Friday. Regards,
Dianella Refaey Rusiecki

name: de Grazia
text:
Hi, the invoice for the February work is attached with the timesheets. One line covers the emergency call out on the 12th which was agreed by the site manager. If anything looks wrong send it back and I will correct it. Payment terms are the usual thirty days. Thanks,
de Grazia

name: Elischa
text:
Hi, the spare key is back under the flowerpot and the alarm code is unchanged. Please lock the side gate. Thanks,
Elischa

name: Williams
text:
Hi, the camp booking for july is confirmed and the balance is due by the 1st. The kit list is attached. One form still needs a signature, the medical one for the second child. Thanks,
Williams

name: Episcopo Koçpinar Radermecker
text:
Hi, the energy certificate has come through and it is a c rating, which is better than the valuation predicted. I have printed two copies, one for the file and a second for the tenants. The works list for the loft can wait until the spring. Let me know when you want to review it. Regards,
Episcopo Koçpinar Radermecker

name: Daniel-Lucian Tillott
text:
Hi, the parcel for the flat upstairs is with us and the buzzer is broken again. Can you collect when you are back. Cheers,
Daniel-Lucian Tillott

name: Aslam
text:
Hi, the order for the new radios has been approved and the invoice needs your code. The delivery slot is Thursday morning so please leave someone on the loading door. The old sets go back in the same box. Thanks,
Aslam

name: Heleen
text: Heleen here, my delivery slot was moved twice and the app still shows the old one, i took the morning off work for nothing. The driver cannot give a window when i call and the chat just sends the same link. Could someone tell me when the van is actually coming, i need to plan around school pick ups.

name: Rüger
text: Rüger writing about ticket 8842, the refund was approved two weeks ago but nothing has landed, the app shows pending. Can you check where it is stuck.

name: Haleema Aunchalee
text: Haleema Aunchalee reporting a repeat fault, the hallway light on floor two has failed for the fourth time this year. Each visit fixes it for a week. Can someone check the fitting itself rather than replacing the tube again. Photos are on the ticket.

name: Nouadjeu Doppelreiter
text: Nouadjeu Doppelreiter here with an update on case 5521, the damp surveyor finally came and found the leak is from the balcony above. Our landlord is responsible but is dragging his feet on the repair. I have all the reports and the photos dated. Please escalate to the housing team before the mould spreads.

name: Juul
text: Juul here, the app crashed while i was paying and the order went through twice. I only wanted one. Can you cancel the duplicate.

name: Bekri
text: Bekri here, my season ticket renewal shows the wrong price band and the deadline is friday. The office said to email in but the reply takes days. Can this be corrected on the system so i can pay the right amount.

name: von Hardenberg
text: von Hardenberg here, writing about the shared path that floods outside our gate, it has been reported twice and each time the reply says it is not adopted. The drain cover is clearly blocked with leaves and grit. The water reaches the step now. Please send the gully team before the next storm.

name: Madou Leonardus
text: Madou Leonardus here, my prescription was sent to the wrong pharmacy and the script has already been collected by someone else. Can it be reissued today.

name: Isolina
text: Isolina here, the community minibus has failed its inspection on a brake light and the trip is saturday. The garage can fit us in friday if the part arrives. Can you chase the supplier and confirm by thursday.

name: Kudelski
text: Kudelski here, the leak under the kitchen sink came back after the last visit and the cupboard floor is swollen. The plumber changed the trap but not the seal behind it. I have dried it out twice this month. Can someone come with the right part this time and check the whole run.

name: Viselka Derouwaux Frauche
text: Viselka Derouwaux Frauche here, my direct debit was set up twice under two references, both are active and both charge on the 1st. Please merge them before the next payment.

name: Mehrgardt Suvat
text: Mehrgardt Suvat here, the ski passes we ordered have the wrong names printed, mine is fine but the other three are swapped. The office opens at nine and we travel friday so this needs sorting quickly. Can you reissue them for collection at the desk.

name: Mina
text: Mina here. Quick update on the fire door order, the fitter has confirmed the 12th and the hinges arrive thursday. The corridor will be blocked for the morning so the library team have moved their session to the hall. Two doors need painting after fitting but that can wait. Let me know if the 12th clashes with anything.

name: Cristofaro
text: Cristofaro here, the meeting pack is ready and the room is booked. One printer jam held things up but the copies are done now. See you at ten.

name: Sourlier Alati Spreter
text: Sourlier Alati Spreter here. The grant application is submitted and the reference number came back straight away. The school has confirmed the venue for the workshop series and the dates are on the sheet. One consent form is still missing, i will chase it today.

name: Adélaïde Dhaisne Ük
text: Adélaïde Dhaisne Ük here. The windows order has gone in and the survey is booked for the 7th. They asked for access to every room so please clear the sills and take the curtains down where you can. The scaffolding goes up the day before and will cover the front path. Any issues, ring the office.

name: Majk
text: Majk here. The spare laptop is charged and in the drawer with the charger. The login is the same as yours, reset it when you are in. Cheers.

name: Mainardis
text: Mainardis here. The hedge cutting starts on monday and the contractor will work from the road side first. Please move the bins off the verge and keep the dog in while they are on our stretch. The whole job takes three days.

name: De Cocinis
text: De Cocinis here. The choir tour deposits are all in and the coach is booked with a pickup at the church. We still need two more rooms filling before the discount applies, so mention it at rehearsal. The final balance is due at the end of the month. I will post the room list on friday.

name: Kulikov Garibay
text: Kulikov Garibay here. The tickets for the comedy night are at the desk under your name. Doors open at seven and the table is reserved. See you there.

name: Sehzada
text: Sehzada here. The broken panel on the noticeboard has been fixed and the new glass is in. The old notices were photographed and put back in order. The spare pins are in the tin. Let me know if anything else needs replacing.

name: Krasnodebski
text: Krasnodebski here. The year end stock count is set for the 30th and the plan is on the wall by the office. Each area has two counters and the sheets are printed in the folders. Please check your area list before then and flag any known issues. We start at seven sharp.

name: Thavam Nahil
text: Thavam Nahil here. The new bins arrived and the old ones go back with the delivery driver. Please use the green one for glass from now on. Cheers.

name: Alojzije Lorent
text: Alojzije Lorent here. The coach for the away game leaves at noon and the kit is already loaded in the front locker. We need two more parents on the gate rota, the sheet is by the door. Bring a rain jacket, the forecast is grim.
